system.moveDescription:
When you engage in an activity related to the su pernatural or the occult for the first time, imagine what your actions would look like as a move. Say what triggers the move and roll with Sensitivity.

[ON hit] it works; work with the Keeper to write the move—it is now a move all Mavens can use for the rest of the game and your roll stands.

[ON 7-9] you must also mark the Crown of the Void.

[ON miss] it’s not something the Mavens can ever do and you also mark the Crown of the Void.

Note: The Keeper can require you to have a strong fictional justification for doing so before attempting to trigger this move.
